question: Show the conference name and year and the number of participants for each conference.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conferences" AS SELECT "conference_id" AS "conference_id", "conference_name" AS "conference_name", "year" AS "year", "location" AS "location" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conference_participation" AS SELECT "conf_id" AS "conf_id", "staff_id" AS "staff_id", "r" AS "role" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW conferences AS SELECT conference_id, conference_name, year, location FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW conference_participation AS SELECT conf_id, staff_id, r AS role FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT c.conference_name,
       c.year,
       COUNT(cp.staff_id) AS participant_count
FROM conferences c
LEFT JOIN conference_participation cp
  ON cp.conf_id = c.conference_id
GROUP BY c.conference_name, c.year
ORDER BY c.year, c.conference_name
S:
